prompt: Listen and choose the best response.
promptZh: 請聽錄音，選出最適當的回應。
spokenPrompt: Has the skating rink posted the beginner schedule on its website yet?
spokenPromptZh: 滑冰場已經在官網公布初學者的時段了嗎？

options.text: I left my skates in the car.
options.whyZh: 冰鞋放在哪裡，無法回答場館是否已公布時段。

options.text: The beginners meet by the north entrance.
options.zh: 初學者在北側入口集合。
options.whyZh: 北側入口是集合地點，不代表初學時段已經公布。

options.text: The website still lists only the advanced sessions.
options.zh: 網站上還是只列了進階時段。
options.whyZh: still only 說網站依舊只列進階場次，間接回答初學時段還沒公布在網站上。

explanationZh: still only 說網站依舊只列進階場次，間接回答初學時段還沒公布在網站上。
evidence: Has the skating rink posted the beginner schedule on its website yet? / The website still lists only the advanced sessions.

vocabulary.note: post 此處指讓資訊可供大眾查看，例如刊在網站上。
